display.purpose: Used for the app and page titles.

body.purpose: Used for controls, tables, and supporting copy.

micro.purpose: Used only where dense operational metadata requires it.

caption.purpose: Used for compact chart and status metadata.

table-label.purpose: Used for table headers and concise supporting labels.

metadata.purpose: Used for breadcrumbs and secondary workspace information.

motion.name: workspace-enter
motion.purpose: Short, subtle feedback for workspace and tab changes.

motion.name: control-response
motion.value: color, background-color, border-color, opacity, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
motion.purpose: Consistent control hover and focus response.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact ink command button for an explicit primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1C2826; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 10px 16px; font: 600 14px Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2B3B38; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Field
components.description: Minimal form control that preserves a clear input affordance.
components.css: .ds-field { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5EAE7; border-radius: 5px; color: #1C2826; padding: 10px 12px; font: 400 14px Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus { border-color: #176B5E; outline: 2px solid #176B5E; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Text navigation whose active and focused state is conveyed by a green underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: #687572; padding: 0 0 7px; font: 600 14px Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item.is-active, .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { border-bottom-color: #176B5E; color: #1C2826; outline: 0; }

narrative.overview: TrueProfit is an internal operations workspace for affiliate performance, influencer management, proposals, progress tracking, and KPIs. It uses an open, nearly-white canvas where hierarchy comes from deliberate type, spacing, alignment, and only the minimum necessary control affordance.
keyCharacteristics: Purpose before decoration: every visible element supports navigation, decision-making, input, feedback, or status.
Whitespace carries structure: ordinary sections are not wrapped in layout cards.
Reserved signal: green is for active navigation, focus, and intentional positive emphasis.
Dense data stays legible: tables keep their fields and scroll on compact screens.
Movement confirms change: interaction feedback is short and restrained.

rules.name: Reserved Signal
rules.body: Green is not a decorative wash. It signals the current navigation state, focus, or a semantic positive state. Status colors already tied to data retain their meaning.

rules.name: Whitespace Carries Structure
rules.body: Separate ordinary sections with consistent vertical rhythm and alignment rather than cards, colored section backgrounds, or layout borders.

rules.name: Flat Functional Overlays
rules.body: Dialogs, menus, and sidebars use a white surface and a quiet 1px rule only where a boundary is needed. Shadows and blur are prohibited.

dos: Use whitespace and consistent alignment to group operational content.
Use one icon library for familiar compact actions only.
Use 160-180ms transitions and support reduced motion.
donts: Do not use cards, colored bands, or borders as ordinary layout scaffolding.
Do not add shadows, blur, gradients, decorative emoji, or ornamental icons.
Do not turn navigation or filters into pill collections.
Do not alter application behavior, data flow, or data-backed semantics during visual work.
